content: FastAPI now documents SSE natively (fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/server-sent-events) alongside StreamingResponse; sse-starlette's EventSourceResponse is the common third-party route. SSE frames carry optional 'event' (type) plus required 'data' (JSON payload), content-type text/event-stream, each frame terminated by a blank line. Typed multi-event streams (status/token/complete) are the standard shape for LLM answers. Browser EventSource is GET-only and cannot set an Authorization header, so authenticated LLM streams use POST + fetch + ReadableStream reader instead. Next.js App Router proxies via app/api/*/route.ts returning the upstream stream.
